purpose: Make development, air-support, security, and later government-policy mechanism assays comparable without hiding distinct outcomes inside one utility score.

cost_denominators.preferred: within-seed gross incremental government organizational-capital outflow during the intervention relative to the matched baseline
cost_denominators.development: incremental nominal public-development outflow when isolating development allocation/dose; also report total incremental government outflow to expose crowd-out
cost_denominators.air_support: incremental combat-event government-capital outflow attributable to the support operator; also report total incremental government outflow
cost_denominators.force_equipment: no dollar-equivalent denominator until a separate acquisition/operating-cost calibration exists; report supply/readiness/terrain burdens and government losses instead
cost_denominators.net_capital_change: never use as the primary cost denominator because unrelated inflows can offset intervention outflow

normalization.reporting_rule: For interventions with an explicit capital cost, report outcome improvement per 1,200 incremental capital in addition to raw effect and raw spend.
normalization.usd_mapping: If an external calibration later assigns B USD to one default monthly federal policy budget, then 1 capital unit = B/120000 USD and 1200 capital = 0.01*B USD. No B is assumed here.

durability.requirement: Measure at intervention end and again after intervention-specific settings return to baseline.
durability.retention_ratio: final paired improvement / intervention-end paired improvement when the intervention-end effect is positive and nontrivial
durability.rule: Do not call an intervention durably suppressive when its apparent end-of-intervention gain substantially disappears or reverses after withdrawal.

decision_rule.method: Pareto comparison across suppression, cost, government losses, civilian harm/displacement, and durable state outcomes.
decision_rule.dominated_intervention: An intervention is dominated when another tested intervention is no worse on every declared comparison dimension and materially better on at least one, subject to sampling uncertainty.

guards: Synthetic effect sizes are not empirical COIN returns.
Do not infer a real-world operational recommendation from a synthetic mechanism ranking.
Do not compare a costed intervention to an uncosted force-composition profile as though both had dollar denominators.
